questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following number series?

12, 24, 36, 46, 56, ?, 72
questions.solution:
**Given series**: 12, 24, 36, 46, 56, ?, 72

The logic followed here is:

**Even numbers starting 12 are added to two terms, then 10 are added to the next two terms, and so on.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/139b75ee5e229bcbf27d8d6f9764a9367312934d5dd88c5fe28a7c516c9f9948.png] 

 
• 12 + **12** = 24
 
• 24 + **12** = 36
 
• 36 + **10** = 46 
 
• 46 + **10** = 56
 
• 56 + **8** = **64** 
 
• 64 + **8** = 72

Hence, the correct answer is **64**.

questions.solution:
The given series: 6, 11, 33, 65, 141, ?

It is an alternate series as shown below:

6 × 2 - 1 = 11

11 × 2 + 11 = 33

33 ​× 2 - 1 = 65

65 ​× 2 + 11 = 141

141 ​× 2 - 1 = 281

Hence, **281 **will be the next term in the series.

questions.question:
What will come in the place of question mark (?) in each of the following number series?

9, 13, 20, ?, 51
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

⇒ (9 + 1²) + 3 = 13

⇒ (13 + 2²) + 3 = 20

⇒ (20 + 3²) + 3 = **__32__**

⇒ (32 + 4²) + 3 = 51

Hence, the correct answer is **"32".**

87, 88, 79, 104, ?, 136
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

⇒ 87 + (1)² = 88

⇒ 88 - (3)² = 79

⇒ 79 + (5)² = 104

⇒ 104 - (7)² = __**55**__

⇒ 55 + (9)² = 136

Hence, the correct answer is **"55".**

questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**(First Number) x 1 + (1)² = (Second Number),**

**(Second Number) x 2 + (2)² = (Third Number), and so on...**

⇒ 4 × 1 + 1 = 5

⇒ 5 × 2 + 4 = 14

⇒ 14 × 3 + 9 = 51

⇒ 51 × 4 + 16 = __**220**__

⇒ 220 × 5 + 25 = 1125

Hence, the correct answer is **"220".**
